name: Window Interstage (Between Coats)
intent: Inspect cured first coat, light sand, patch any defects, spot coat patches, clean dust before second coat. Like trim and doors, windows always sand between coats regardless of QT.

tasks.name: Inspect Window First Coat
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 20 windows/hr (3 min/window) for inspection of cured coat 1.

tasks.name: Sand Window Between Coats
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 10 windows/hr (6 min/window) for fine-grit sanding between coats.

tasks.name: Patch Window Defects
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 25 windows/hr (~2.5 min/window) for spot patch of isolated defects.

tasks.name: Spot Coat Window Patches
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 30 windows/hr for spot brushing over patched areas.

doctrine: Window interstage fires for all QTs because windows take a satin/semigloss finish that reveals defects. Sand rate (10 win/hr) is slower than the prep sand (8 win/hr would be wood prep) because the painter is being precise around fresh-dry paint. Most rates here are gap-filled estimates.
